title: House cat vs tiger at bath time
storyboard: Film: one actor plays a house cat refusing a bath, then a tiger cannonballing in; same bathroom, 2 takes

scenes.headline: House cat at bath time: 'Absolutely not.'
Tiger at bath time: 'Is there a deeper end?'
Tigers are adept swimmers
scenes.body: In the wild they've even been recorded hunting in water. This one is just enjoying a zoo pool.

caption:
Same family. Very different bath energy.

Tigers range across Asia, from Russia all the way to Sumatra and mainland Southeast Asia, and many of those habitats include rivers and mangroves.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo (Tiger).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Two-character contrast skit (actor plays the bath-hating house cat, then the tiger) with real tiger footage as the payoff; captive pool clip is labelled as a zoo pool.
